observed_issue: Values resolve through user.user_id -> vendors.user_id rather than direct vendors.vendor_id.
validated_decision: Validated; preserve source schema and normalize vendor identity downstream.

observed_issue: Metric data contains mixed semantics: some values are direct vendors.vendor_id and others correspond to vendors.user_id.
validated_decision: Validated; use an analytical vendor identity mapping before integration.

observed_issue: Populated values align with user.user_id, not consistently with customers.customer_id; customer identity is reached through customers.user_id.
validated_decision: Validated 135/135 populated references; do not directly join to customers.customer_id.

observed_issue: Three shipments contain order items belonging to multiple orders.
validated_decision: Shipments 103, 180 and 218 are consolidated; use shipment_items -> order_items -> orders for complete attribution.

observed_issue: Column name suggests an address, but declared target is hub_master.hub_id; ID 1 also collides numerically with address.id.
Values do not match payment_transactions.id; payment_receipts.transactionId matches payments.transaction_id.
validated_decision: Treat as payment/business transaction identifier, not payment_transactions primary key.

observed_issue: Notification reference values are context-dependent and may represent different workflow entities.
validated_decision: Resolve using notification type/context; do not create one universal FK.

observed_issue: Party ID target depends on party_type: Vendor maps to vendors.vendor_id; Customer maps to customers.customer_id, with one observed customer identity requiring the user bridge.
validated_decision: Resolve party using party_type and customer identity mapping.

observed_issue: One exchange request has no replacement order; some attempts have no shipment.
validated_decision: Treat as workflow-state conditions; do not interpret every request/attempt as a completed replacement.

observed_issue: Five QC history records have NULL order_item_id while retaining shipment context.
validated_decision: Treat these as shipment-level QC workflow records unless later evidence establishes item attribution.

observed_issue: Populated values include GST-style transporter identifiers and did not resolve to tested internal logistics/user identifiers.
validated_decision: Keep as external/business identifier; do not force an internal FK.

observed_issue: All populated values are the sentinel/workflow value fallback_default and do not match tested numeric rule IDs.
validated_decision: Treat fallback_default as a workflow/business rule code.

observed_issue: Several candidate fields are entirely NULL or belong to empty tables, so their intended relationships cannot be empirically validated from current data.
validated_decision: Document as currently unvalidated; NULL does not mean invalid.
